implementation: TopModule preserves the original one-bit ports and positive-edge synchronous active-low reset. Moore outputs implement the one-cycle f pulse, consecutive 101 detection, two y sampling opportunities, and permanent high/low outcomes until reset. No added ports or pipeline latency.
verification: Independent three-bit sample-history oracle and response timer; exhaustive eight-bit x histories, directed first/second/late y response, repeated reset, bounded timeout, fatal mismatches, explicit PASS.
